title: The descent set of the superstandard tableau determines the dominance order of the shape
author: Avichai Marmor
work: Schur-positivity of short chords in matchings
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the labelled lemma `lem:superstandard characterize coefficients` at source lines 570-577: it identifies the descent set of the superstandard tableau T_lambda with [N-1] minus the partial sums of the conjugate partition lambda', and it asserts that any tableau with that descent set has a shape dominating lambda' and is unique when the shape is exactly lambda. The author's proof (source lines 582-588) is a single-page argument that is not bookkeeping: it picks the first column i where a competitor T differs from T_lambda (line 585), reduces the dominance inequality mu' > lambda' to the statement that the i-th column entries of T_lambda all occur in the i-th column of T, and then analyses a minimal misplaced entry x by cases on its column j, using that x is the minimal entry of its column when j > i so that x-1 ceases to be a descent (line 587). The uniqueness clause is read off from the same analysis; the statement records none of the column-wise reasoning.
